title: SDRF evidence manifest
description: Provenance the producer of an SDRF hands to the independent reviewer: the sources it used and which value each source supports. It is provenance, not proof. Explanation: skills/sdrf-adversarial-review/references/review-contract.md.

artifact.description: Path of the SDRF this manifest describes.

id.description: Short name that claims cite in source_ids.

kind.description: e.g. repository, publication, supplementary, search-output, raw-file.

location.description: Exact URL, PMCID/DOI or local path.
Column and rows the claim covers, e.g. 'characteristics[organism] rows 1-12'.

source_ids.description: Ids from sources[].id that support the value.

evidence.description: What the cited sources say, at the granularity of the value.

limitations.description: Evidence that was unavailable or weaker than the values need.
